title: almagestd config
description: Main HuJSON/JSON configuration file for almagestd. The daemon owns Config and Logs; the engine owns nodes; pasta workspace owns the capitalized keys inside each node object. Node implementations own non-capitalized keys inside node objects and may add, remove, or reinterpret them dynamically.

Protected.description: Optional protected configuration object accepted when almagestd reads the config from --stdin. File-based configs should keep these settings in the separate protected config file.

IdleMilliseconds.description: Autosave debounce time in milliseconds. Non-positive values are accepted by the daemon but are treated as the default 500 ms.

tlsBuiltinCAOptions.description: Generation options for the daemon-owned built-in TLS CA. The daemon stores the generated certificate and private key in the runtime file-storage directory. Empty or omitted ValidityDays means no practical expiration.

Issuer.description: Certificate subject common name and issuer common name.

ValidityDays.description: Certificate validity in whole days. 0 uses the daemon no-expiration fallback.

Curve.description: ECDSA curve. Ignored for non-ECDSA keys.

KeyBits.description: RSA key size in bits. Ignored for non-RSA keys.

logCacheConfig.description: Daemon-owned per-level in-memory log cache sizes. Missing values use daemon defaults; negative values are clamped to 0.

engineNodesConfig.description: Engine-owned main workspace configuration, keyed by pasta node name.

workspaceNodeConfig.description: A pasta workspace node record. Capitalized properties are workspace-owned. Properties that do not start with an uppercase ASCII letter are reserved for node implementation-owned state and are intentionally not documented here.

Class.description: Workspace-owned pasta node class name. Nodes without a string Class are ignored during restore.

Primary.description: Workspace-owned primary type override. Omitted when it equals the class default and has no retained HuJSON comment.

Pos.description: Workspace-owned opaque node position string used by the UI/workspace.

Links.description: Workspace-owned outgoing link specifications from this node's right ports to other nodes' left ports.

^[^A-Z].*$.description: Node implementation-owned state. Node classes may add, remove, or reinterpret these keys dynamically; by convention node-owned keys must not start with a capital ASCII letter.

nodeName.description: Pasta node name. Node names must be non-empty and cannot contain '[' or ']'.

className.description: Pasta class name, such as example.com/ClassName. The suffix starts with an uppercase ASCII letter.

typeName.description: Pasta type name, such as example.com/typeName, or the wildcard any/any. The suffix starts with a lowercase ASCII letter.

portName.description: Pasta port name. It must start and end with an ASCII alphanumeric character and may contain ASCII whitespace, space, '-', and '_' in between.

linkSpec.description: Outgoing link in pasta save format: '<right port> -> [<target node>] <left port>'. Target node names cannot contain '[' or ']'. Port names are restored only if valid for the target node class or placeholder.
